rca of the issue: Repro: load homepage and inspect browser console. Errors repeat: '<circle> attribute cx/cy: Expected length, undefined'. Likely source is Carry.jsx motion.circle where animate prop resolves to empty object when paused/reduced, resulting in invalid SVG attributes. Mitigation: provide stable cx/cy defaults or conditional rendering that never emits undefined attrs.
